checks: Active game enters its existing pause dialog and writes a save.
Repeated interruption preserves the existing settings dialog.
A controlled completion-dialog fixture remains open without a second modal.
WebKit browser reload recovers the interrupted save.
Moving identical HTML to a different absolute file path retains the save in this WebKit browser context.
limitations: Tests the exact injected JavaScript against frozen HTML. Does not execute UIKit/WKWebView, test native notifications, native import/export, native WebKit persistence, or a physical iPhone.
